title: devx manifest
description: devx.yaml is a flat map of task names to task definitions, plus a handful of reserved top-level keys (version, project, ai, tools, setup, vars, includes, agents). Any other top-level key is a task name. See docs/manifest.md and docs/design/task-executor-refactor.md.

vars.description: Plain textual ${VAR} substitution defaults. Lowest priority in the CLI override > inherited env > .env/.env.local > vars: chain.

includes.description: Merges another devx.yaml's tasks into this one's graph, namespaced as "<name>:<task>". Not a recursive sub-process per file — one flat merged graph.

agents.description: Named shell commands launchable via 'devx workspace agent <name>'.

ai.description: Optional AI configuration used by 'devx ai'. Credentials are read from environment variables — never stored in devx.yaml.

provider.description: LLM provider. Credentials: openai=OPENAI_API_KEY, anthropic=ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, azure-openai=AZURE_OPENAI_KEY, ollama/local=no key required.

model.description: Model identifier, e.g. gpt-4o-mini, claude-3-5-haiku-latest, llama3.2

baseURL.description: Override the API endpoint. Required for azure-openai. Optional for ollama (default: http://localhost:11434).

local.description: Local inference backend configuration used by 'devx ai setup/status'.

backend.description: auto picks MLX on Apple Silicon and Ollama elsewhere.

autocompleteModel.description: Fast model used for tab completion. Defaults to qwen2.5-coder:14b.

tools.description: Required SDKs, runtimes, and CLI tools. Checked by 'devx doctor', installed by 'devx setup' (or 'devx doctor --fix').

setup.description: Ordered host-side commands run by 'devx setup' after tool installation.

runOnce.description: Skip if hash of run: matches the last successful run.

envFiles.description: Local config/secrets files to scaffold from a template on first 'devx setup'. Each is only ever created, never overwritten, once its output file exists.

name.description: Shown in 'devx setup' output. Defaults to output.

template.description: Path to a Go text/template file, relative to this devx.yaml. Vars are available as {{.VAR_NAME}}.

output.description: Path the rendered template is written to, relative to this devx.yaml. Skipped if this file already exists.

envVar.description: OS environment variable checked first. Defaults to name.

prompt.description: Interactive prompt label. Defaults to name.

default.description: Used when no env var is set and not running interactively (or the prompt is left blank).

secret.description: Documentation only — devx does not log this value, but terminal input is not hidden.

additionalProperties.description: Every other top-level key is a task name. A task is either a bare string (shorthand for {run: <string>}) or an object with the fields below.

run.description: Shell command executed via the system shell (sh -c / cmd /C).

deps.description: Task names (or "<include-namespace>:<task>") that must complete/become ready before this task runs.

dir.description: Working directory for run:, relative to the defining devx.yaml's own directory. Defaults to that directory.

detached.description: True starts the task in the background and continues the graph once it's ready; inferred from run: text (docker run -d, &, etc.) when omitted.

interactive.description: True attaches the task directly to the terminal (stdin/stdout/stderr), skipping readiness/parallelism — for one task run alone, e.g. 'devx run shell'.

ready.description: How devx decides a detached task is ready. Exactly one of http, tcp, or cmd. When omitted, readiness is inferred from run: text.

http.description: URL polled until it returns a 2xx/3xx status.

tcp.description: host:port polled until the socket accepts a connection.

cmd.description: Shell command polled until it exits 0.

port.description: Port this task listens on, for devx's port-collision checks. Inferred from run: text when omitted.

containerName.description: Overrides the container name devx infers from run: (used by devx down/logs/exec/status). Set explicitly if the name can't be parsed from run:.

requires.description: Binaries that must be on PATH for this task to run — checked by 'devx doctor'.

sources.description: Glob patterns. Combined with generates: to skip re-running a one-shot task when its outputs are newer than its inputs.

generates.description: Glob patterns of files this task produces. See sources:.

os.description: Restricts this task to the listed OSes; skipped (not an error) on any other OS.

timeout.description: Duration string (e.g. "30s", "2m") after which devx kills the task and treats it as failed.

stopTimeout.description: Duration devx waits after SIGTERM before sending SIGKILL on 'devx down'. Defaults to 10s.

restart.description: Only meaningful for detached tasks. Defaults to never. Reserved for a later phase: validated and persisted today, but devx does not yet restart a detached task after its process/container exits.

shell.description: Overrides the shell used to run run: (defaults to sh -c on Unix, cmd /C on Windows).

group.description: Logical grouping used by 'devx up --group <name>' to run a subset of the graph.

scope.description: shared tasks may not reference ${workspace}/${port}-style per-workspace substitutions — they're meant to be started once and shared across workspaces.
